mentions.name: Shoggoth.db
mentions.description: Shoggoth.db is a self-organizing database designed for experimenting with AI agents without letting them roam freely, providing a contained environment to test agent behavior.
mentions.problem: Experimenting with AI agents normally requires letting them roam freely; this offers a safer, contained way to run such experiments.
